title: Split finite-sheet image-pullback model of the canonical intersection
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a normed extension of Q_ℓ, and p:U→X finite etale surjective. Let P be a pro-etale locally finite free rational module on X, M a pro-etale locally finite free integral module on U, and e:Ext(M)≅p^*P. Use coefficients [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], module objects [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the actual global intersection N of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-lattice-intersection]. There exists a pro-etale covering C of X with compact members such that, on each member, for some finite r,n,m and F⊣G the integral extension/restriction adjunction, there is a mono i:F(O^r)→F(O^n), its cokernel is isomorphic to F(O^m), and the normalized pullback of N is isomorphic to imagePullback(G(i), η_(O^n)). This states the finite-sheet comparison, not a kernel description or local freeness of N.

proof.text: Take the compact finite-sheet coordinates of the two canonical maps. Exact normalized inverse image preserves the image-pullback by imagePullbackMapIso. Transport the resulting pullback along eA,eB,eD with imagePullbackCongr, using the two supplied commuting-map equations. The mono and free-cokernel data are unchanged. This proves the split model without leaving any hole in its proof.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousLatticeIntersection_splitModel
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P))
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X) [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [Surjective p]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
    (hM : ∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ s : D.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj M))
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) U)).obj M ≅
      (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P) :
    ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      CompactSpace (C.X s) ∧
      let R := condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (C.X s)
      let T := (ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) ⋙
        Mod.comap (inv (condensedPullbackHom (integralCoeff ℓ E) (C.f s)))
      let F := Mod.extendScalars
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))
      let G := Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (C.X s)) Ab.{u + 1})
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))
      let adj := Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))
      ∃ (r n m : ℕ) (i : F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R r) ⟶ F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R n)),
        Mono i ∧ Nonempty (cokernel i ≅ F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R m)) ∧
        Nonempty (T.obj (latticeIntersection (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X P p M e) ≅
          imagePullback (G.map i) (adj.unit.app (Mod.finiteFree R n)))
